Palm API Guide Data Structures

Here are the data structures with brief descriptions:
BookKeeping_t
BtConnectable_tStructure used to pass bluetooth connectable settings to/from daemon
BtConnSetup_tConnection setup structure passed in during HxBtOpen request
BtCtlOpts_tStructure used to pass bluetooth io control requests from drivers/applications in to the bluetooth stack
BtDevInfo_t
BtLinkInfo_t
BtMsgAuthenticate_t
BtMsgGenericData_t
BtMsgHeader_tMessage structure filled with the associated event
BtMsgPairComplete_t
BtMsgPairingDialog_t
BtMsgPinCodeRequest_t
BtMsgPinCodeResponse_t
BtMsgTrustedDev_t
BtOptions_t
BtProfOpts_t
BtProfSetup_tStructure used to define the characteristic of the desired profile
ConnInfoStructure containing information pertaining to the current connection
ConnProfile
ConnProfileParam
ConnSetupInfoStructure binds the BtConn_t type with the setup_opts used to establish the connection to the remote device
HxArray_tHxArray
HxBtMsg_t
HxColor_tColor structure defined by four channels, with 8 bits each
HxGadgetObject_t
HxImageButtonObject_tImageButton object structure
HxImageObject_tImage object structure
HxInputEvent_t
HxPoint_tHxPoint_t is defined by x and y coordinates
HxPolygon_tPolygon used for drawing in HxGraphicsDrawPolygon and HxGraphicsFillPolygon
HxRectangle_tHxRectangle_t is defined with a point and extent
HxRfcomm_t
HxSegment_tSegments used for multi-line drawing in HxGraphicsDrawLines
HxSpan_tA horizontal line specified by x and width, used by HxGraphicsFillSpans
HxTextObject_tText object structure
HxUserObject_tUser-defined object structure with two pointers
HxUserRawObject_tUser-defined object structure with eight bytes
